description: This Java source file defines an abstract test class 'TenantApiTests' for testing tenant-related API functionalities in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes test cases for retrieving tenant information, handling authorization failures, and querying tenants by trust anchor, along with utility methods for test setup.

classes.name: TenantApiTests
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common test cases for tenant API functionalities within the Eclipse Hono project. Designed for extension to implement specific client retrieval methods.

methods.name: testGetTenant
methods.description: Test case verifying the retrieval of an existing tenant, checking properties and configurations for correctness.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsIfNotAuthorized
methods.description: Test case verifying that retrieving tenant info without proper authorization fails with HTTP 403.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsForNonExistingTenant
methods.description: Test case verifying that requesting a non-existent tenant results in a 404 error.

methods.name: testGetTenantByCa
methods.description: Test case verifying retrieval of tenant info by trust anchor, including validation of the trust anchor details.

methods.name: testGetTenantByCaFailsIfNotAuthorized
methods.description: Test case verifying that unauthorized attempts to retrieve tenant info by trust anchor fail with HTTP 403.

methods.name: getRandomPublicKey
methods.description: Utility method to generate a random RSA public key for test purposes.
